common: modern JRPG illustration, bold clean dark lineart, flat cel shading with only 2-3 tones per color, large clean color areas, no texture, no noise, no speckled details, no gradients, no glow. Flat pure green #00FF00 background, no shadow, no ground, no effects, no text, no numbers, no labels. Generous spacing, do not shrink any frame.

characters.hero_sera: Sera, a young female knight: brown hair in a high ponytail tied with a blue ribbon, brown eyes, silver plate armor with gold trim, black gloves, a white and blue tabard with a gold lily emblem, a blue skirt with armored tassets, no cape, holding a longsword.

characters.leona: Leona Valenstein, 26-year-old senior royal knight and mentor, calm dependable mature expression, athletic build, dark-blonde low ponytail, gray-blue eyes, gunmetal full plate with steel-blue trim, white tabard with navy shield crest, short navy half-cape on one shoulder, longsword at hip, kite shield on back. This is an unapproved design proposal.
characters.npc: Two separate fantasy JRPG NPC portraits: left a friendly adult female guild receptionist, short chestnut bob, brown vest/white blouse/guild badge/ledger; right Mia, an 8-year-old refugee girl, light brown braided hair, patched travel cloak/scarf, hopeful tired expression.

variants.A: Exactly three full-body neutral figures: front, right-facing side, back. Straight-on character design reference, no overhead perspective. Prioritize a clean enlarged front design and consistent turnaround.
variants.B: Exactly three full-body neutral figures: front, right-facing side, back. Straight-on character design reference, no overhead perspective. Prioritize precise silhouette, matching armor seams and a clean readable face across all views.

variants.A: Sera: 2x2 four equal square waist-up portraits, same framing and head size: top-left default calm, top-right determined, bottom-left gentle smile, bottom-right surprised. Body turned three-quarters right. Exact fixed Sera identity, brown eyes, no cape.
